title: Processing Frozen Archival Human DNA Samples for Oxford Nanopore Sequencing
author: Alicia Wenghöfer
materials: frozen DNA samples
Qubit Flex Fluorometer
Agilent TapeStation 4200
Agilent Femto Pulse System
Diagenode Megaruptor 3 Shearing Kit
Megaruptor 3 shearing syringe
Part 3: Shearing (~ 03:00:00 for 8 samples)
Use Short Fragment Buffer (Part B
Mix thoroughly by gently flicking the tube or very gently pipetting up and down 10x, and then spin down.

Using a Thermocycler, incubate samples at 20 °C for 00:30:00 and then 65 °C for 00:05:00 and then 4 °C for infinity. Note: Start and pause Thermocycler to allow lid to come to 85 °C before putting samples in.
Resuspend the AMPure XP beads by vortexing.
Transfer DNA samples to clean 1.5mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Add 60 µL (or equivalent volume to the previous sample-end-prep-mix, see
of resuspended beads to the reaction and mix by flicking the tube 10x. Do not pipette mix here as beads may clump around the pipette tip.
Incubate on a rocking laboratory shaker or hula mixer for 00:05:00 at Room temperature .
Prepare 500 µL per sample of fresh 80% ethanol in nuclease-free water.
Spin down and pellet sample on magnet until eluate is clear and colorless, about 00:02:00
Keep the tube on the magnet and pipette off the supernatant. Note: Can retain if needed just in case the final elution quantification is uncharacteristically low.

With the samples remaining on the magnet, wash the beads with 200 µL of 80% EtOH, pipetting on the opposite wall making sure not to disturb the pellet. Once EtOH has been added to all samples, immediately remove and discard the EtOH. Note: The goal here is to make sure the beads are fully covered. If initial volume of beads was significantly higher than 60 µL , more EtOH may be required.
Spin down and place the tube back on the magnet, pipetting off any residual EtOH.
Allow to dry for ~ 00:00:30 but do not overdry to the point of cracking.

Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and resuspend the pellet in 62 µL nuclease-free water. Incubate on a rocking laboratory shaker or hula mixer for 00:03:00 at Room temperature . If not quantifying the sample post-DNA repair and end-prep, user can resuspend the pellet in 60 µL water.
Spin down and pellet the samples on a magnet until eluate is clear and colorless.
Remove and retain 62 µL of eluate into a clean 1.5mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Optional: Quantify 1 µL of sample on the Qubit. Note: It is possible to store samples at 4 °C Overnight at this step if necessary.
Quantify 1 µL of sample on the Qubit.

Re-prep library from Part 6 if . Calculate the mass (ng) of DNA need to achieve this based on averaging the size of DNA from the Femto Pulse traces using https://nebiocalculator.neb.com/#!/dsdnaamt . This should allow a coverage of 30x over three loads. If your sample differs from this size, recalculate based on 10-20 fmol per load. Note: For example, 740 ng would be enough for three loads of 370 ng each, which is calculated for 20 fmol of DNA averaging at 30 kb. If necessary, user can load a higher fmol on the first load and lower fmol on the next two loads.

steps.title: Thaw and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen archival human DNA samples on ice and assess their purity and concentration.

substeps.instruction: Thaw DNA samples on ice.
Quantify purity (absorbance ratios 260/280 and 260/230) using 1 µL of the sample (taken from the middle of a 10x pipette-mixed aliquot) on a NanoDrop.
Quantify concentration using 1 µL or 2 µL of the sample (from the middle of the pipette-mixed aliquot) on a Qubit Flex Fluorometer.
Determine DNA size using an Agilent TapeStation 4200 or Agilent Femto Pulse System (expected size >40 kb). For Femto Pulse, use dilutions between 0.005-0.5 ng/ul in 1x TE or EB-Buffer.

steps.title: Prepare DNA for Shearing
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA sample for the Diagenode Megaruptor 3 Shearing Kit (E07010003) based on concentration and size.

substeps.instruction: In a Megaruptor 3 shearing tube, adjust the sample to a volume of 100-150 µL and a concentration of 100-150 ng/ul using TE Buffer or water (do not exceed 180 µL or 150 ng/ul).
If sample concentration is >70 ng/ul, dilute to 100 µL rather than 150 µL to maintain concentration above 70 ng/ul.
If sample concentration is <70 ng/ul, do not dilute; use the total sample volume.
Select needles: use fluid + needles (gray) for viscous high molecular weight DNA (>100 kb), otherwise use standard needles (black).

steps.title: Shear DNA
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical shearing using the Megaruptor 3 system.

substeps.instruction: Attach the shearing syringe to the tube and place into MR3 slots (use 1st and/or 8th slots for <8 samples to maintain balance; use empty tubes/syringes to balance odd numbers).
Set shearing frequency based on size: shear 1x if size is >30 kb; shear 2x if size is >100 kb (manually restart the cycle for the second shear).
Shear at speed 20.
Remove the sample and carefully remove the syringe, ensuring the plunger is fully depressed to avoid sample loss.
Aspirate any leftover sample on the syringe using a P20 pipette.
Mix by gently flicking the tube and spinning down; do not vortex.

steps.title: Post-Shear Quantification
steps.instruction: Verify the size and concentration of the sheared DNA.

substeps.instruction: Quantify samples on the Qubit and size using Agilent TapeStation 4200 or Agilent Femto Pulse System (targeted size 30 kb, observed range typically 30-70 kb).

steps.title: Size Selection via BluePippin
steps.instruction: Perform high-resolution size selection using the BluePippin system.

substeps.instruction: Dilute up to 10 µg of sheared DNA into a final volume of 60 µL using TE.
Configure software: Select '0.75 Agarose Dye-free' cassette, and choose '10 Kb High Pass Plus Marker U1' or '15 Kb High Pass Plus Marker U1'.
Enter Sample IDs and Marker (Lane 4). Ensure 'End Run when Elution is Completed' is checked.
Select all rectangle blocks in the Range column except the Marker well (dark grey).
Set Reference Lane to lane 4 and apply to all lanes.
Enter '10000' (for 10 kb) or '15000' (for 15 kb) in the BP 'Start' field.
Calibrate the instrument: Place calibration fixture (dark side down) on the optical nest, press 'Calibrate', and ensure target 'Target I ph,mA' reads '0.60'.
Inspect cassette for bubbles under a light source; do not use affected lanes for the marker.
If air bubbles are behind elution wells, tilt cassette sample-well side down and tap sides.
Place cassette in optical nest, slightly tilted down.
Remove 450 µL buffer from large reservoirs (unless levels were already low).
Remove buffer chamber adhesive strips via white tabs.
Completely remove all buffer (~90 µL) from each elution module.
Add 80 µL electrophoresis buffer to each well slowly.
Seal elution modules with adhesive tape strip.
Perform Continuity Test; ensure 'PASS' message appears.
Remove 40 µL buffer from marker well and 80 µL (for 60 µL sample + 20 µL LS) from sample wells.
Remove adhesive strips from sample wells.
Add 40 µL marker to marker well.

Prepare samples by adding Loading Solution (LS) based on volume: for 60 µL sample, add 20 µL Standard LS; for 30 µL sample, add 10 µL Standard LS; for 70 µL sample, add 10 µL 2x LS. Mix and pulse-centrifuge.
Dispense samples slowly just below the buffer surface; top off under-filled wells with electrophoresis buffer.
Start the run.
Wait at least 45 minutes (or overnight) after the run before removing samples from elution modules.
Optional: Add 80 µL Tween solution to empty elution modules, wait 1 minute, and collect to increase yield by 10-30%.

steps.title: Final DNA Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform final quality control before library preparation.

substeps.instruction: Quantify samples on Qubit and NanoDrop and size using Agilent TapeStation 4200 or Agilent Femto Pulse System.
Ensure at least 2.5 µg of DNA is available for library prep.

steps.title: Library Preparation (SQK-LSK114)
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA library using the Oxford Nanopore Ligation Sequencing Kit V14 with specific modifications.

substeps.instruction: Follow the standard SQK-LSK114 protocol with these tweaks: Use 2.5 µg DNA library in 48 µL (Part A Step 2); add 45 µL AMPure XP beads (Part B Step 10); use Short Fragment Buffer (Part B Step 14); incubate for 20 minutes at 37 °C and 300-450 x g (Part B Step 18).

steps.title: Priming and Loading Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Prime the R10.4.1 flow cell (FLO-PRO114M) and load the prepared library.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SB), Library Solution (LIS) or Library Beads (LIB), Flow Cell Tether (FCT), and Flow Cell Flush (FCF) at room temperature; vortex and spin down.
Prepare priming mix: Add 30 µL FCT to 1170 µL FCF and vortex (or 25 µL FCT to 975 µL FCT for master mix).
Remove air bubbles from inlet port 1 using a P1000 pipette (draw back 20-30 µL).
Flush 500 µL priming mix into inlet port 1. Wait 5 minutes.
Dilute DNA library to 32 µL at 20 fmol using EB.
Prepare library loading mix: 100 µL SB, 68 µL LIS or LIB, and 32 µL DNA library (20 fmol).
Repeat the air bubble removal and flush 500 µL priming mix into inlet port 1.
Gently mix the library mix and load 200 µL into inlet port 1.
Close valve and PromethION door. Wait 10-60 minutes before initiating sequencing.

steps.title: Sequencing Run and Reloading
steps.instruction: Configure the PromethION run and manage library reloading.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to 'Start sequencing' (ensure 2TB storage per sample).
Select flow cell position, enter experiment/sample ID, and select kit 'Ligation Sequencing Kit SQK-LSK114'.
Set run limit to '75 hours duration', minimum read length '200 bp', and Adaptive Sampling 'off'.
Set data output to '.POD5'.
Start sequencing and check for air bubbles after 10 minutes.
Reload the flow cell every 24-48 hours (up to 3 loads of 20 fmol) based on pore usage.

To wash for reload: Mix 2 µL WMX (do not vortex) with 398 µL DIL (vortexed). Load 400 µL wash mix into inlet port 1, wait 1 hour, and remove waste (920-950 µL) from port 2 or 3. Repeat priming and loading steps.

steps.title: Optional Library Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover unused library if insufficient for 3 loads.

substeps.instruction: Remove 220 µL from inlet port 1 (last library load), place on ice.
Add 20 µL SB, pipette mix, and add any remaining library.
Use this mixture for subsequent loads.

steps.title: Post-Run Cleanup
steps.instruction: Finalize the run and recycle materials.

substeps.instruction: Ensure basecalling is 100% complete.
Remove flow cells and send back to Nanopore for recycling.
